uniques.name: 100,000 Steps
uniques.power: Ground Stomp's damage is increased by #% plus an additional amount based on the distance traveled since the last casted Ground Stomp's, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: "While many Barbarians remained in the Dreadlands, small groups from the Oxen, Crane, and Bear tribes instead chose to search the land for a new home." -A History of the Children of Bul-Kathos

uniques.name: Accord of the Wilds
uniques.power:
Your Companion Skills each gain 1 additional companions and deal #% bonus damage.

Gain the Passive Effect of Ravens, Wolves and Poison Creeper for free.
uniques.flavor: You do not see your reflection on the ring's polished surface. Instead, you see other forms: creatures of fur and feather, of fang and claw.

uniques.name: Ae'grom's Schism
uniques.power: Ae'grom and its summons deal #% increased damage. You additionally summon Ae'grom's other half and gain a second Charge of Command Ae'grom.
uniques.flavor: "Cut a demon nice and wide. Something rises from inside. Eye and fang, bone and sinew. What was one has become two." -Ravings of a mad Vizjerei

uniques.name: Ahavarion, Spear of Lycander
uniques.power: Gain a random Shrine effect for # seconds after killing an Elite enemy. Can only occur once every # seconds.
uniques.flavor:
"The angel Lycander left us a portion of her power in this spear. It is all the proof I need that she watches over us still."
- Oracle Argoysni

uniques.name: Airidah's Inexorable Will
uniques.power: Storm Strike chains to twice as many targets and gains #% bonus damage.
uniques.flavor:
"When I was born, I breathed in the wind and the storm and they gave me life. When I die, I will breath out, and return that gift to the skies."
- Journal excerpt

uniques.name: Anathema of the Primes
uniques.power: Hitting enemies with a Core Skill increases the damage they take from you by #% per Skill, up to #%. Archfiend Demonform Skill Variants are Core Skills and cost Wrath.
uniques.flavor: Hatred begins the first cut. Terror holds the wound. Destruction comes at last, patient and certain, to devour what remains.

uniques.name: Ancients' Oath
uniques.power: Enemies hit by Steel Grasp take #% increased damage from you for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Weapons wielded by the fiercest warriors often catch the eye of the Ancient spirits. If the wielder is worthy, the spirits may bless the steel with their strength." -Gerti, Oxen Tribe Forgemaster

uniques.name: Andariel's Visage
uniques.power: Lucky Hit: Up to a #% chance to trigger a poison nova that deals #% of the damage dealt over # seconds to enemies in the area.
uniques.flavor: The horrific whispers of the Maiden of Anguish flicker through your mind, pushing you ever closer to madness...

uniques.name: Arcadia
uniques.power: Rally Fortifies you for #% of your Maximum Life. Whenever you recover #% of your Maximum Life, gain a charge of Rally.
uniques.flavor: No wasteland may weary the bearer of Arcadia. Beneath their path, the soil remembers its first spring, and blades of war soften into petals.

uniques.name: Argent Veil
uniques.power:
Arbiter's Evade triggers a random equipped non-Channeled Core Skill for every # meters traveled.

Core Skills deal #% increased damage during Arbiter's Evade and for # seconds after.
uniques.flavor: "And the moon looked upon the pilgrims and wept a path of light. Through her tears they walked unseen, and night remembered them no more." - Orison XVII: Creed of the Dove

uniques.name: Arioc's Needle
uniques.power: Gain #% Deadly Strike Chance. Your Deadly Strikes deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: For decades, the spearhead lay encased in resin, warded with runes, and sealed in a block of granite. So feared was the venom infused in its tip, taken from the fang of a great spider, long extinct.

uniques.name: Arreat's Bearing
uniques.power: Your non-Ultimate Skills that summon Ancients will now summon an additional one. Skills that summon Ancients deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "Rise clansmen and reclaim our trampled honor! Ancients' blood runs through us all! We are storms: earth breaking, maelstrom wielding. The fire of the gods burn still! They are with us!" -Ealda

uniques.name: Asheara's Khanjar
uniques.power: Hits with this weapon increase your Attack Speed by #% and damage by #% for # seconds, up to #% and #% respectively.
uniques.flavor: When Caldeum's gates closed, Asheara led her Iron Wolves out of the city knowing full well they would never return. Instead they roamed Kehjistan pledging their blades to any who were in need.

uniques.name: Assassin's Stride
uniques.power:
Mobility Skills are always Shadow Imbued with #% increased potency.

Lucky Hit: Damaging an Elite or Boss with a Mobility Skill has up to a #% chance to instantly trigger a free Shadow Imbuement explosion.
uniques.flavor: The Viz-Jaq'taar descended on the mages indiscriminately and silently as a plague. The wise took flight, whilst the foolish fortified their dwellings as if walls or wards protected from shadow.

uniques.name: Autumnal Crown
uniques.power:
Wind Shear now deals # Poisoning damage over # seconds.

Lucky Hit: Wind Shear has up to a #% chance to restore # Spirit.
uniques.flavor: "Lo, Éirin has departed, she wanders with us no longer. May her peace be everlasting under the branches of Glór-an-Fháidha." -Inscription at Túr Dúlra

uniques.name: Axial Conduit
uniques.power: Casting Chain Lightning has a #% chance to activate # to # additional times.
uniques.flavor: "Do not confuse your manipulation of lightning as control. The azure flame is its own master and needs no hand to wield it. You are merely a conduit for its chaos." -Ascribed to the mage Woh

uniques.name: Azurewrath
uniques.power: After Freeze expires, enemies take #% of the damage you dealt to them while Frozen.
uniques.flavor: The ancient runeblade of the angel Izual, Azurewrath was miraculously spared the corruption that consumed its master.

uniques.name: Balazan's Maxtlatl
uniques.power:
Your Casts damage Close enemies for #% of your Thorns and also deals #% of this damage as Poisoning over # seconds.

Each time you've retaliated with Thorns, for # seconds the Poisoning damage is increased by #%, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: "Know the dangers of fang and root. One hides in the leaf, the berry, the still water. The other waits in the bite, the stinger, the wound." - Teachings of Balazan, Verse III

uniques.name: Band of First Breath
uniques.power:
Casting Evade consumes # stacks of Resolve to increase your damage dealt by #% for # seconds.

Gain Armored Hide's Passive Effect.
uniques.flavor: A gentle whisper glides upon the winds. The words elude the grasp of mortal ken. They weave through the soul like a melody forgotten, and from this arises a name: Adarja, the First-Breather.

uniques.name: Bands of Ichorous Rose
uniques.power:
Lucky Hit: Poison or Cold Imbued Skills have up to a #% chance to deploy a Poison Trap while it is equipped, depending on your equipped Poison Trap's element.

Poison Trap gains the Infiltrator Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: From the stump of the Blood Rose oozes a foul and black ichor—bane to flesh and blood. Blade and hide treated in the toxics are worth the fortunes of kings.

uniques.name: Bane of Ahjad-Den
uniques.power: While channeling Whirlwind, you now periodically hurl out a Mighty Throw that deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Before Baal's hosts blighted Daken-Shar, the outnumbered northmen clad themselves in barbed mail so that even in death, the demons still bled.

uniques.name: Banished Lord's Talisman
uniques.power: After you spend # of your Primary Resource, gain # stacks of Overpower. Consuming Overpower increases your Critical Strikes damage by #% for # seconds.
uniques.flavor:
"His name has been lost to history, but to have been exiled from a land as cursed as Hawezar, his deeds must have been truly depraved."
- Scholar's Notes

uniques.name: Bastion of Sir Matthias
uniques.power: Blocking has a #% chance to retaliate with a Shield Bash. Your Shield Bash damage is increased by #%.
uniques.flavor: ...And when the enemy pressed too near, his bulwark became a hammer.

uniques.name: Battle Trance
uniques.power: Frenzy gains the Barrage Variant for free and can stack # additional times. While at maximum stacks, you deal #% increased damage and your other Skills gain #% increased Attack Speed.
uniques.flavor:
"The change that overtook my brother in battle was terrifying. His eyes turned hard like diamonds, and the way he moved... it was like he was dancing to music only he could hear."
- Captain Dervin

uniques.name: Beastfall Boots
uniques.power:
When you Cast a non-Channeled Ultimate Skill, it Consumes all of your Energy and deals #% increased damage per Energy Consumed.

Using a Cooldown restores # Energy.
uniques.flavor:
"Genai grew proud and fond of boasting of her hunting prowess. She claimed she was fast enough to catch even the spirit Leraye, who cursed her for such an insult."
- Fable of Genai's Twenty Trials

uniques.name: Bell of the Bovine
uniques.power:
Lucky Hit: Up to a #% chance to Moo when hitting an enemy.

Lucky Moo: Up to a #% chance to summon a Cow that explodes for # Fire damage. This damage is increased by #% on Tuesdays.
uniques.flavor: "The fever racks my body. It dances... rhythmless, endless! I fear there is but one remedy. MORE! I must hear more..." -Lester the Farmer

uniques.name: Bindings of Attrition
uniques.power: Casting Dark Prison consumes #% of your Maximum Life to reset its Cooldown. You gain #% Damage Reduction while Dark Prison is active.
uniques.flavor: "What is more perfect than blood? A single drop can consecrate, empower, or curse. Know this: The most potent form is not blood stolen from others, but given from one's self." -Elias

uniques.name: Black River
uniques.power: Corpse Explosion consumes up to # additional Corpses around the initial Corpse, gaining #% damage and #% Size per additional Corpse consumed.
uniques.flavor: "The scrolls describe a river of tar that separated the living from the land of the dead. Any unfortunate soul who tried to cross would be dragged down into oblivion." -Notes of Scholar Kamien

uniques.name: Blood Artisan's Cuirass
uniques.power: When you pick up # Blood Orbs, a free Bone Spirit is spawned, dealing bonus damage based on your current Life percent.
uniques.flavor: "The infamous Necromancer Gaza-Thul's mastery over blood magic was indisputable. Many suspect that upon his death, his skin was used to fashion this eldritch armor." -Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Blood Moon Breeches
uniques.power:
Your Summons have a #% chance to randomly inflict Decrepify or Iron Maiden when they deal damage.

You deal #% increased Critical Strike Damage to enemies affected by your Curses.
uniques.flavor: A naturally occurring curiosity, the blood moon persists as a sign of woe for the most superstitious Zakarum faithful. Children born under it are often considered cursed and cast out, lest it spread.

uniques.name: Blood Wake
uniques.power: Blood Mist casts Corpse Explosion on surrounding Corpses. When Blood Mist detonates a Corpse, its Cooldown is reduced by # second and you gain #% increased Movement Speed for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "These Priests of Rathma are quite peculiar. Is it possible to dabble in the forbidden yet uphold Balance? Too often, the power of such magic leads to corruption." –The Writings of Abd al-Hazir

uniques.name: Blood-Mad Idol
uniques.power: You are always Berserking but take #% increased damage as Burning over # seconds. While Burning, Berserking grants an additional #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "The relic was fashioned for the broken-hearted and the battle-mad, for those whose rage has nowhere left to dwell." - Notes from Sister Octavia on the Burnt Knights

uniques.name: Bloodless Scream
uniques.power:
Your Darkness Skills Chill enemies for up to #% and deal #% increased damage to Frozen enemies and bosses.

Every # times you damage enemies with Darkness Skills, all Nearby enemies are Feared for # seconds before Freezing for # more seconds.
uniques.flavor: "My companion swung her odd weapon in a wide arc, and our pursuer stopped short. The look of horror on his face as his body fell to pieces will haunt me forever." -The Ebon Pages, Canto II, Verse XI

uniques.name: Blue Rose
uniques.power:
Skills that form Ice Spikes deal #% increased damage.

Lucky Hit: Up to a #% chance to form an exploding Ice Spike, dealing # Cold damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Her lover's spirit faded, and in her sorrow she wept frozen tears. Where they fell, roses of the purest ice would blossom each winter."
- Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 7: "The Myth of Irina Coldheart"

uniques.name: Bridle of Tor'Baalos
uniques.power: Your Brimstones and Molten Bomb deal #% increased damage. Molten Bomb explodes all Brimstones instantly if there are at least 4 total but enemy proximity no longer detonates them.
uniques.flavor: "Destruction can be become an addiction, it is said. The first taste of it leaves you wanting more. Something within us craves ruin, yearns for annihilation." -Black Book of Lam Esen

uniques.name: Bucrani's Grip
uniques.power: Casting Fire Bolt through your Firewall causes it to split into # bolts, each dealing #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Kin of Bo'a, beloved of Bucrani,
Whose path led into the wine-dark pasture.
The victor's sword swings for this alone,
To lop off all thought and memory–a final mercy."
Low of Bo'a, Verse 50-54

uniques.name: Bucrani's Resolve
uniques.power: Casting Chain Lightning has a #% chance to activate # to # additional times.
uniques.flavor: "...In those days, the children of Bucrani were known to many. Great was their sway, and mighty was their squall! How could any realm hold such strong souls?" -Oxridge, Common Histories, fragment II

uniques.name: Bucrani's Tread
uniques.power:
Your Critical Strike Chance is increased by #% of your Movement Speed bonus.

Current Bonus: #%
uniques.flavor:
"Changing, consuming, becoming: this is the way of all life.
I give myself to you, my children, so that you may live."
Low of Bo'a, Verse 112-113

uniques.name: Bucrani's Will
uniques.power: Teleport pulls Close enemies to you and you gain #% Damage Reduction for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: The leather feels warm to the touch, as through life clings to it. A divine purpose still trembles in each fold.

uniques.name: Cage of Madness
uniques.power:
Your Evade transforms you into an angry Lunatic for up to # seconds that explodes dealing Command Fallen's Base damage and you gain #% increased Command Fallen damage every second you are transformed.

While you are an angry Lunatic, your Movement speed is increased by #% and you periodically spawn a Mini Lunatic that seeks enemies.

Command Fallen deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "Sin begets sins as men beget men. Terror begets Hate and Hate begets Destruction. Destruction begets Terror as Terror begets Hate..." -Inscription carved inside the helm

uniques.name: Cassia's Grace
uniques.power: Your Arrow Storms last # seconds shorter, deal #% increased damage, and, when created, have a #% chance to create an additional Arrow Storm on a nearby target.
uniques.flavor: "Tell us, Oracle Queen, of our great Amazon Sister, who wandered far from her home into the Heart of Terror." -Ode to the Warmatron

uniques.name: Cathedral's Song
uniques.power:
Consuming Judgement # times calls down Spear of the Heavens on a random enemy. Judgement on Bosses counts as #.

Your Spear of the Heavens damage is increased by #%.
uniques.flavor: Sing. And so too will they sing. Rejoice. And so too will they rejoice. Fight. And so too will they fight.

uniques.name: Chainscourged Mail
uniques.power: Casting a damaging Brawling Skill disables it afterwards. When all of these Skills that are on your Action Bar are disabled, they become re-enabled with their Cooldowns refreshed. Brawling Skills you Cast deal #% increased damage for each disabled Skill.
uniques.flavor: To chain the kin of Bul-Kathos is to gift them a weapon.

uniques.name: Cluckeye
uniques.power: #% chance to cluck on Cast.
uniques.flavor: This bow has been tainted by some strange magic indeed.

uniques.name: Cluckonomicon
uniques.power: Pecking loose stones grant Henlightenment.
uniques.flavor: One touch and you understand... behind their vacant gaze is a fiendish hunger, patient and unreasoning.

uniques.name: Condemnation
uniques.power:
Your Core Skills deal #% increased damage for # seconds when Consuming 3 Combo Points. Casting Basic Skills always generates 3 Combo Points.

Generating Combo Points allows you to generate the same amount of Combo Points for # seconds when you spend them.
uniques.flavor:
"I've never seen such ruthless butchery. He deserves to be shipped off to die in the swamps with the rest of the godless murderers."
- Witness to the murder of Sergeant Walcot

uniques.name: Coop de Grâce
uniques.power: Lucky Hit: Damage to Injured enemies has up to a #% chance to spawn a flock of explosive chickens.
uniques.flavor: Mercy ends where the flock begins.

uniques.name: Cowl of Malefic Torment
uniques.power: Hex dooms enemies, maintaining the Hex and dealing #% of Doom's damage every second until they die. Doom deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "The doomed do not fall at once. They linger, falter in purpose, and then unravel. Breath shortens. Will erodes. Fortune abandons them. When death finally comes, 'tis merely overdue." -Warlord Bartuc

uniques.name: Cowl of the Nameless
uniques.power: Lucky Hit: Imbued Skills have up to a #% chance to trigger a large explosion, dealing #% of the damage dealt and applying the Imbuement effect to each enemy it hits with #% Potency.
uniques.flavor:
"He is banished from the Guild, his name stricken from the Book. His punishment is to never have been."
- Excerpt from a burned parchment

uniques.name: Craze of the Dead God
uniques.power:
Direct damage is distributed as Poisoning over the next # seconds and reduced by #%.

Lucky Hit: Direct damage has up to a #% chance based on your Poisoned Life percentage to infect an enemy with Touch of Death.
uniques.flavor: T'an seized a spear and drove it thrice into his mad brother Tan. Alas, the craftier of the twin gods wove one last cunning snare. In place of blood, the wound wept venom and consumed all in its wake.

uniques.name: Crown of Lucion
uniques.power: Each time you use a Skill with a Primary Resource Cost, gain #% increased damage and Resource Cost is increased by #% for # seconds, stacking up to # times.
uniques.flavor: The prince of Hatred, fair as maggots over carrion. He claims no throne, crafts no realms, reigning over only a blackened, bitter heart. Some legends name him banished, while others dread his return.

uniques.name: Cruor's Embrace
uniques.power: Casting Blood Surge picks up # Blood Orbs around you to expel smaller blood novas, dealing #% of normal damage.
uniques.flavor:
In the blood dancer's grasp, a victim lies,
A vessel dried 'neath darkened skies.
Their life extinguished, veins burst and drained,
In Cruor's embrace, forever enchained.

uniques.name: Dark Howl
uniques.power: Debilitating Roar is now a Werewolf Skill. In addition, Debilitating Roar increases your damage by #% while in Werewolf form for the duration.
uniques.flavor: "They who live by fang and claw forget the feeling of human feet on soil. Of cold air on bare skin. Man and beast...thoughts, desires...merge together like blood spilled in a stream." -Nafain

uniques.name: Dark Stalker's Medallion
uniques.power:
Casting a Skill with a Two-Handed Bludgeoning, Two-Handed Slashing, or Dual-Wielded weapon grants #% increased damage for # seconds.

While all three bonuses are active, you gain #% Crowd Control Duration and Attack Speed.
uniques.flavor: "Tried dying once. Didn't care for it." -Renit the Dark Stalker

uniques.name: Dawnfire
uniques.power:
Holy Light's passive now deals # Fire Damage every second in a small area around you. Each time an enemy dies within this aura, it increases its damage by #% and burn area by #% for # seconds, up to # times.

Activating Holy Light Aura refreshes this duration.
uniques.flavor: "Kindle your inner flame. With it, we are the dawn that breaks the night." - Paladin Justelle

uniques.name: Death's Pavane
uniques.power: Dance of Knives drops knives from enemies hit. Picking them up grants you # Energy and increases your Dance of Knives damage by #% for # seconds, stacking up to # times.
uniques.flavor: "The assassin moved as though in a dance - left, pivot, cut. The guests did not realize they had been split until their screams gurgled through the slits in their necks." - An Account at the Red Feast

uniques.name: Deathgrip
uniques.power:
Your maximum number of Skeleton Warriors is increased by #. Skeleton Warriors cleave with their attacks and deal #% increased damage.

Commanding them onto a target increases the damage that target takes from your Skeleton Warriors by #%.
uniques.flavor: "There is something akin to desire that I have sensed in the dead. A longing to serve, to be of purpose in their new state of being. Do not deny them that purpose." -Books of Kalan

uniques.name: Deathless Visage
uniques.power:
Critical Strikes with Bone Spear form an echo that bursts, dealing #% of its normal damage.

Bone Spear deals #% increased Critical Strike Damage.
uniques.flavor: "Rathma is endless. He was the first Ancient, and will remain at the end. He is the master of the Great Cycle of Being. When Death comes for him, why should he fear it?" -Vauntus, Acolyte of Rathma

uniques.name: Deathmask of Nirmitruq
uniques.power: Flurry gains the Transporter Variant for free. You can now overexert yourself while Casting Flurry, spending #% life when you don't have enough Energy. Spending life to Cast Flurry increases its damage by #% and your Attack Speed by #% for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: Beware, for the serpent's spirit lingers. Those who don the Nirmitruq's visage may find their hearts entwined with the viper's wrath.

uniques.name: Deathspeaker's Pendant
uniques.power: Blood Surge casts a mini nova on your Minions, dealing # damage. Damage is increased by #% per target drained by the initial cast, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: Once a sanctum for Rathma's studies, the Temple of the Deathspeaker became a proving grounds for potential leaders of his priesthood. Its halls are filled with the corpses of those who failed.

uniques.name: Desperate March
uniques.power: Evading leaves behind Caltrops. Caltrops gain #% increased Size and deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
"My feet do not ache—there is no greater pain than stopping.
Into the Abyss I go. I will find her. I will bring her home.
Hell cannot keep me from her, but it is welcome to try."
- Unknown

uniques.name: Dirge of Airidah
uniques.power: Storm Skills that you Cast grant # Spirit and deal #% bonus damage. These bonuses are doubled when damaging a Vulnerable, Immobilized or Slowed enemy.
uniques.flavor: "I saw her climb to the peak of the mountains. She played a song on her talharpa, so sad it made the sky darken and rumble with thunder." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IV

uniques.name: Dirge of Odium
uniques.power: Your Basic Skills deal #% increased damage per Wrath you have but you lose #% Wrath per second. Every # Wrath gained beyond your Maximum generates # Dominance.
uniques.flavor: "I am the voice of vengeance unsated. Brandish me and my enmity shall walk with thine. Thy grief is thy tithe. My dirge, the dread reward."

uniques.name: Dolmen Stone
uniques.power: Boulder deals #% increased damage and explodes when it expires.
uniques.flavor: As the hateful mob beat on his door, he gripped the pulsing shard tightly and screamed for calm. When he opened his eyes, all that greeted him was silence and the blood-smeared ruins of his cottage.

uniques.name: Doombringer
uniques.power: Lucky Hit: Up to a #% chance to deal # Shadow damage to surrounding enemies and reduce their damage dealt by #% for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: Whenever this ancient sword has reappeared throughout history, it portends a time of great strife, as well as a devastating loss of life.

uniques.name: Drognan's Anguish
uniques.power: Casting Pyromancy Skills Burns you for #% of your Maximum Life over # seconds. You inflict #% increased Burning damage based on how much of your Life is Burning.
uniques.flavor: Made from the finger of a silver-haired mage

uniques.name: Eaglehorn
uniques.power: Penetrating Shot bounces off walls and deals #% more damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Scholars have been unable to decipher the runes carved into this bow, however all agree they are related to its uncanny ability to bend arrows towards their targets."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Earthbreaker
uniques.power:
Casts of Landslide leave behind Tectonic Spikes that deal # Physical damage over # seconds.

Spawning a Landslide pillar within Tectonic Spikes has a #% chance to spawn two instead.
uniques.flavor: When Arreat was sundered, the world quaked. The Druid Aglainn journeyed far to chronicle the aftermath. Grief-stricken by the great mountain king's fall, he rent the earth anew.

uniques.name: Ebonpiercer
uniques.power: Blight also shoots # smaller piercing projectiles, each dealing #% of Blight's defiled area damage.
uniques.flavor: This talisman was the life's work of Deathspeaker Jurdann. Following his premature demise, Jurdann's successor wore the amulet in tribute as they trialed against the Temple of the Deathspeaker.

uniques.name: Echo of Kwatli
uniques.power:
You deal #% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

After making an enemy Vulnerable, your next direct damage dealt to them:
Heals you for #% of your Maximum Life
Generates # Vigor
Removes the Vulnerable effect
uniques.flavor: "Strike once to expose weakness, strike again to exploit it." -Teachings of Ysevete, the First Spiritborn

uniques.name: Eggcecutioner
uniques.power: Slain enemies have a chance to lay an egg.
uniques.flavor: Each soul it severs returns as an omen of renewal, cradled in bone-white curve.

uniques.name: Eggis
uniques.power: Blocking an attack has a chance to turn the attacker into a Feared chicken for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: The Eggis was not forged, but laid by a beast most fowl.

uniques.name: El'Druin, Sword of Justice
uniques.power: Your attacks condemn enemies. When they become Injured, they are smote for # Holy damage for each time they were condemned, up to # times.
uniques.flavor: You hold Justice itself in your hands.

uniques.name: Elegy
uniques.power: Blazing Scream is now an Archfiend Skill and deals #% increased damage. Blazing Scream gains the Skull Splitter Variant for free and the Lesser Demon skulls deal the same damage as the main skull.
uniques.flavor: Weave a song from the damned. Pluck their sorrows like harp strings, for there is fuel in the tears of the profane.

uniques.name: Emberfury
uniques.power: Overpower increases your Pyromancy Skill damage by #% and size, Mana cost and Cooldowns by #%.
uniques.flavor: The greatest power is often the shortest lived.

uniques.name: Emblem of Staalbreak
uniques.power: Berserking's damage bonus is increased by #%. While not Healthy, you are always Berserk.
uniques.flavor: An old mark of office from the town of Staalbreak, in the Dreadlands. The rage of its last owner still emanates from within.

uniques.name: Endurant Faith
uniques.power: When you would be damaged for at least #% of your Maximum Life at once, it is instead distributed over the next # seconds and reduced by #%.
uniques.flavor: Despite the Light's blessings, countless Knights Penitent were hewn apart by the infernal hordes. Remnants of their steel lie scattered through the Hells – dwindling lights in the chaos.

uniques.name: Esadora's Overflowing Cameo
uniques.power: Crackling Energy's discharge rate is increased by your Attack Speed, it's damage is increased by #%, and each hit has a #% chance to reduce a random Cooldown by # second.
uniques.flavor: The only thing more potent than Esadora's magic was her endless hatred of humanity. As she lay dying, the pale amulet around her neck drank in both.

uniques.name: Esu's Heirloom
uniques.power:
Your Critical Strike Chance is increased by #% of your Movement Speed bonus.

Current Bonus: #%
uniques.flavor:
"While scholars have proven these boots were not created by Esu herself, it is noteworthy that they have been passed down since the formation of the Mage Clans."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Etna's Lost Dagger
uniques.power:
Dealing # different types of Non-Physical damage increases the Potency of your Imbuement Skills by #% and Non-Physical damage by #% for # seconds.

Basic Skills are now Imbueable.
uniques.flavor: "Prepare thoroughly before approaching any warlock. Fill your elixirs, replenish your arrows. Oil and sheath your blades before you depart." -Arts of the Viz-Jaq'taar

uniques.name: Eye of Baal
uniques.power: Soul Shard Skills and their demons deal #% increased damage. Casting a Soul Shard Skill increases all your damage by #% for # seconds, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: "When the moon turns crimson, it is Baal's eye opening. Show him acts of destruction, and he will reward you with power." -Rites of the Triune

uniques.name: Eyes in the Dark
uniques.power: Death Trap deals #% increased damage and will rearm itself after activating, once every # seconds.
uniques.flavor:
"And so, when the sun dipped behind the hills each night, he knew that Ashen Jack would soon be near. Watching, and waiting."
- Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 2: "Each Long Night"

uniques.name: Fang of the Vipermagi
uniques.power: Inferno constricts the area # more times and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The venom from these fangs was known to cause severe blisters and burns - forever. The Zann Esu were known to use them to fashion blades, supplementing their own abilities.

uniques.name: Fields of Crimson
uniques.power: Rupture's rip deals #% of the total Bleeding damage on an enemy instantly, removing all Bleeding damage from them.
uniques.flavor: "We've been fighting these flesh-eaters for so long, been soaked in so much blood, that after a while it's difficult to tell what side you're truly on." -Daelyr, Crane Tribe warrior

uniques.name: Fist of the Iron Rose
uniques.power:
Damaging a Close enemy with Marksman or Cutthroat Skills each grant a #% Attack Speed bonus for # seconds.

While both Attack Speed bonuses are active, you deal #% increased damage to Close enemies.
uniques.flavor: "She wished only to protect her sister. She journeyed far to Ivgorod. After years of training she returned home, being the only outsider to ever master the six techniques." -Legends of the Iron Rose

uniques.name: Fists of Fate
uniques.power: Your attacks randomly deal #% to #% of their normal damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life."
- Zurke

uniques.name: Flamescar
uniques.power: Incinerate gains one final charge, irradiating the area around you and increasing damage dealt by #% but costing an additional # Mana per second.
uniques.flavor: The burn may heal, but the pain is eternal.

uniques.name: Flameweaver
uniques.power: Casting Fire Bolt through your Firewall causes it to split into # bolts, each dealing #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Driven to surpass Esu, the wizard Naridan's reckless enchantments caused an inferno, devastating the ancient town of Cagrim. Only the gauntlets remained - a solemn warning to all who dare tame fire.

uniques.name: Fleshrender
uniques.power: Tornadoes deal #% increased damage and when expire, they instead seek back toward you.
uniques.flavor:
"This weapon is a reminder of the unbridled savagery of our druidic ancestors, the wisdom of which I see more clearly with every day that passes."
- Moreg, Druidic Scholar

uniques.name: Fleshwrit Carapace
uniques.power: Sigil Skills deal #% increased damage. Active Sigils gain # kills every second and unused kills are saved when they expire.
uniques.flavor: "...Our rites are written not with ink, but with blood. Not upon stone, but upon the living flesh..." -Taphya 13:6

uniques.name: Flickerstep
uniques.power: Each enemy you Evade through reduces your active Ultimate Cooldown by # seconds, up to # seconds.
uniques.flavor:
"Considered a failure by their creator, it wasn't until the assassination of an "untouchable" Caldeum noble that these boots' true power was understood."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Footfalls of the Waning World
uniques.power: Your Evade is now Nether Step and your Evade Cooldown is reduced by # seconds as you lose or consume Shadowform stacks.
uniques.flavor: Step onward, and the living realm shall dim behind thee as the Black Road uncoils, eternal and cold. Even death shall fail to follow thee there.

uniques.name: Fractured Runestone
uniques.power: Your Earth Skills deal #% bonus Critical Strike damage. This bonus is increased to #% with at least # stacks of Overpower. You passively gain 2 stacks of Overpower every # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "The runestones in Scosglen are fascinating. Some act as wards, but others are conduits. They tap into the deepest power of the earth itself." -Donan

uniques.name: Fractured Winterglass
uniques.power:
Casting a Core Skill has a #% chance to summon a Conjuration of the same element.

Each active Conjuration grants:
#% increased damage
# Mana per second
#% Movement Speed
#% Damage Reduction
uniques.flavor: Winterglass refracts light and also manipulates mana - forming complex arrays of spells and enchantments. These distinct characteristics possess great power, yet the outcomes remain unpredictable.

uniques.name: Frostburn
uniques.power:
Lucky Hit: Up to a #% chance to Freeze enemies for # second.

You deal #% increased damage to Frozen enemies.
uniques.flavor: A touch so frigid it stops the heart and chills the very soul.

uniques.name: Fury of the Wilds
uniques.power:
When you Shapeshift into either Werewolf or Werebear form, you gain Berserking for # seconds. Additionally, Berserking grants # stack of Ferocity every # second while active.

Berserking's damage bonus is increased by #%.
uniques.flavor: The ring pulses with primal power, but its design is delicate. Perhaps its main purpose is to remind the wearer that they are still human.

uniques.name: Galvanic Azurite
uniques.power:
Cast Shock Skill damage leaves enemies Magnetized for # seconds, causing them to emit Crackling Energy and receive #% increased Shock damage from you.

Crackling Energy's damage Pulls Magnetized enemies together.
uniques.flavor: "This gem acts as a conduit for aetheric filaments, enabling the wielder to summon atmospheric discharge at will." - Excerpt from Volatus Arcanum: Of Skybinding and Stormcraft

uniques.name: Gate of the Red Dawn
uniques.power:
Juggernaut Core Skills are empowered, dealing #% increased damage to the first enemy hit and storing the damage dealt to that target, up to # times.

Fortress unleashes this stored damage to all enemies within its area.
uniques.flavor: Between fire and darkness, I hold the gate.

uniques.name: Gathlen's Birthright
uniques.power:
Cyclone Armor is automatically triggered once every # seconds.

Gain Cyclone Armor's passive and it grants you #% Damage Reduction if you are Human.
uniques.flavor: 'Twas Gathlen, most tender warden of the elder realm, who reigneth o'er grove and glade. Whosoever he favors shall inherit the wilds. Utter his name, and be embraced.

uniques.name: Gauntlets of Sheol
uniques.power: While Fiend of Abaddon is alive you periodically sacrifice all other Archfiend Summons, dealing Fiend of Abaddon's damage around them and increasing Fiend of Abaddon's damage by #% per demon killed, up to #% for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: All of Abaddon is unshrouded before you. The denizens of Sheol tremble, for these hands are the touch of those unutterable ruins.

uniques.name: Gift of Frost
uniques.power: Ice Armor gains the Permafrost Variant for free and has #% increased potency.
uniques.flavor: Legend says those who survive the Hall of Mirrors emerge forever changed, able to enchant objects with an innate cold.

uniques.name: Gladiator's Triumph
uniques.power: The first direct damage you deal to an enemy is a guaranteed Critical Strike. When a Marksman Skill first Critically Strikes, it gains #% increased damage, and you gain # Overpower. This can stack up to # over your Maximum Overpower.
uniques.flavor: The Philios Games were said to welcome the prideful, the reckless, and the condemned.

uniques.name: Gloves of the Illuminator
uniques.power: Fireball now bounces as it travels, exploding each time it hits the ground, but its explosion deals #% of normal damage.
uniques.flavor: After Inarius returned to Sanctuary, he sought a way back to the High Heavens. His first step was to reignite the religion he had abandoned millennia before: the Cathedral of Light.

uniques.name: Godslayer Crown
uniques.power: When you attempt to Incapacitate an enemy, you mark them and all surrounding enemies, pulling them in and dealing #% increased damage to them.
uniques.flavor:
"The Sahptev faithful believe in a thousand and one gods. If it takes me as many lifetimes, I will find and kill them all."
- Gaspar Stilbian, Veradani Outcast

uniques.name: Gohr's Devastating Grips
uniques.power: Whirlwind deals #% increased damage and pulls enemies to you every # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "The brutish construction of these gloves belies the strength they bestow. Gohr was clearly no craftsman, but it would be foolish to ignore the triumph of his work." -Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Gospel of the Devotee
uniques.power: Your Basic Skills gain all Upgrades for free. Damaging an enemy with a Basic Skill causes them to take #% increased damage from your other Basic Skills for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Tremble not before the one who has mastered a thousand incantations. Tremble before the one who has made a single spell his gospel, his body, his breath." -One Who Never Sleeps

uniques.name: Grasp of Shadow
uniques.power: Casting a Marksman or Cutthroat Skill has a #% chance to Summon a Shadow Clone that mimics that Skill.
uniques.flavor: Dark wisps creep hungrily across these gloves, like an assassin's blade seeking a life to steal on a moonless night.

uniques.name: Gravewalker's Hand
uniques.power: Your Essence Generation is increased by #%. Your Bone Skills deal #% increased damage for each point of Essence you have when Cast, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: "There is a point one can reach, a oneness with the Balance, when a single, silent gesture is enough to summon an army of bone to your command." -Necromancer Mehtan

uniques.name: Greatstaff of the Crone
uniques.power: Claw gains all Variants for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "She has existed in Scosglen since before Fiacla-Géar walked the land. Her purpose is a mystery to us all. However, approach her with deference; she may grant you her counsel."-Airidah, to Donan

uniques.name: Greaves of the Empty Tomb
uniques.power: Sever leaves behind Desecrated Ground that deals # Corrupting damage over # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "The massive door to my family's crypt, which had taken a dozen men to close, was thrown open. Had I known the horrors to come I never would have set foot inside!" -The Ebon Pages, Canto I, Verse VII

uniques.name: Greenwalker's Oath
uniques.power: Poison Creeper gains the Germinate Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Ciódan was known to be a true friend of the Deep Forest. In gratitude, he was protected fiercely by nature itself.

uniques.name: Greenwalker's Signet
uniques.power: Casting or Channeling a Human Skill has a #% chance to trigger an additional equipped non-Ultimate Human Skill. Human Skills deal #% bonus damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Do not speak to nature. Listen to it. Learn from it. That is the only true path of knowledge."
-Code of the Scéal Fada

uniques.name: Griswold's Opus
uniques.power:
Dealing direct damage grants #% increased Critical Strike Damage for each enemy hit within # seconds, up to #%.

At Maximum you gain:

Lucky Hit: Critical Strikes have up to a #% chance to deal double damage, Heal for # Life, and refresh the duration of the bonus.
uniques.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.

uniques.name: Hail of Verglas
uniques.power: Gain Ice Shards' Piercing Cold upgrade. Ice Shards deals #% bonus damage.
uniques.flavor: "Ere the age of mage and king, storms raged so dread and fell that men named it the wrath of gods. Its hail smote the earth till mountains were wrought..." -Tome recovered from Kasama

uniques.name: Hand of Apotheosis
uniques.power: Any Demonform grants you all Metamorphosis Upgrades for free and they are #% more potent.
uniques.flavor: "There are certain thresholds one must not cross. Not because the demonologist will lose their way back, but because they will not return the same as they were before." -Grimoire of Reckoning

uniques.name: Hands of the Worldbreaker
uniques.power:
Apocalypse deals up to #% increased damage when cast in Sigil of Chaos based on the number of kills the Sigil has stored.

Apocalypse is now also a Sigil Skill.
uniques.flavor: "For demons whose nature is to destroy, where does it end? If everything around them is brought to ruin, I believe their final act of destruction would be themselves." -Deckard Cain

uniques.name: Hangman's Hand
uniques.power: Sever deals #% increased damage and sends out # additional specter to attack a nearby enemy.
uniques.flavor: "The executioner's hands are imprinted with the essence of every life they have taken. They do not understand this, though. But we who seek Balance do." -Books of Kalan

uniques.name: Harlequin Crest
uniques.power: Gain +# Rank to all Skills.
uniques.flavor:
"This headdress was once worn by an assassin disguised as a court mage. Her treachery was unveiled, but not before she used its magic to curse the king's entire lineage."
- The Fall of House Aston

uniques.name: Harmony of Ebewaka
uniques.power:
According to your secondary Spirit Hall choice, your Skills are all additionally Jaguar, Eagle, Gorilla, or Centipede Skills.

Your Skills deal #% increased damage per Spirit type they have.
uniques.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.

uniques.name: Heart of Azgar
uniques.power: When you hit at least 1 enemy with Maul, increase its Attack Speed by #% and damage by #% for # seconds, stacking up to # times.
uniques.flavor: "You kept us from harm. Forever will you hold a place of honor. We will always look up to you...brother." -Grey of Clan Skeld

uniques.name: Hecaton Chasm
uniques.power: Tyrant's Grasp deals #% increased damage and summons # additional demonic hands in all directions.
uniques.flavor: "The creatures of Hell are craven, wretched things, clawing at scraps like mongrels. Hells' hundred hands do not fight. They clamber forward like cowards in the dark." -Tal Rasha

uniques.name: Heir of Perdition
uniques.power:
Succumb to hatred and earn Mother's Favor. Slaughtering enemies briefly steals #% Critical Strike Chance from surrounding allies with Mother's Favor.
Mother's Favor always grants you #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Beware false prophets donned as sheep yet bearing the stench of wolves. Thou shalt know them by their fruits. For a tree of good cannot produce evil, nor thorns yield a harvest sweet and fair.

uniques.name: Hellbrand Signet
uniques.power: Sigil of Chaos gains the Diabolic Rebuke Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "The fire of that realm is not like the fire of our world. It seems alive. Not mindless, but imbued with purpose. As if it were blood flowing through unknowable veins." -Jere Harash

uniques.name: Hellhammer
uniques.power: Upheaval gains the Iron Burst Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The demon prince Ikonoth slew hundreds of the Heavenly Host with this infernal hammer before falling to none other than the Archangel Imperius himself.

uniques.name: Hellhound's Sabatons
uniques.power: Abodian deals #% increased damage. Command Abodian periodically triggers your Non-Archfiend Hellfire Skills while moving and its Cooldown is reduced by #%.
uniques.flavor: "As loyal as we may think they might be, they are still demons. And they will take any chance they can to destroy us." -Book of Adria

uniques.name: Henri's Perquisition
uniques.power: You gain Primary Stat equal to #% of your Dexterity.
uniques.flavor: "It's just a cat," said Ankaj. Her uncle leaned in, "You are spiritborn. Look deeper." In its amber eyes, Ankaj saw the passing of ages, fixed on a single thought: "Mouse." The cat smacked its lips.

uniques.name: Herald of Zakarum
uniques.power:
Gain #% increased Strength, Resistance, Armor and Retribution Chance.

Retribution gains #% increased Size.
uniques.flavor: "Praise Akarat, His will be done. Lead us to darkness, so our Light may shine and purify." - Zakarum prayer

uniques.name: Herald's Morningstar
uniques.power:
Blessed Hammer deals #% increased damage.

Lucky Hit: Up to a #% chance to spawn a base Blessed Hammer on the target hit.
uniques.flavor: First in the Swan, the Herald by name. This is the star of morning that shines brightest, which marshals the order of all other celestial bodies.

uniques.name: Hesha e Kesungi
uniques.power: The Protector can be invoked at range and Pulls inward with its smashes. Enemies in its area take #% increased damage from your Gorilla Skills, doubled while they are Knocked Down or a Boss.
uniques.flavor: Wreathed in bark and bone, these gauntlets carry the strength of old simian spirits - wardens of root and canopy.

uniques.name: Hooves of the Mountain God
uniques.power: Casting a Basic Skill while at Maximum Fury causes your Fury to increasingly Drain until you run out, during which your Basic skills now cleave dealing #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
Break their bones beneath your weight,
Fell their walls and breach their gate.
In his halls we'll boast and sing,
And praise our honored mountain king!

uniques.name: Howl from Below
uniques.power:
Instead of detonating immediately, Corpse Explosion now Summons a Volatile Skeleton that charges at a random enemy and explodes.

Corpse Explosion deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "Can you not hear it? That endless scream from the cold earth beneath your feet!? They are down there, trapped, blind with rage! Waiting to drag us down into the sod!" -Ravings of Madman Gustav

uniques.name: Hunter's Zenith
uniques.power: When Hurricane ends or after it lasts # seconds, an explosion occurs dealing #% of the total damage dealt by up to # hits of Hurricane.
uniques.flavor:
"By fang, claw, spear, or sword - send the bastards back to the flames from which they crawled! Soak the peat with their blood! For Fiacla-Géar! For Scosglen!"
- Nafain, during the Days of Ash

uniques.name: Iceheart Brais
uniques.power: Your Conjurations periodically unleash Frost Nova. Enemies affected by Frost Nova take #% increased damage from you.
uniques.flavor: The mad artisan saw his fingers turn black from frostbite as he worked the cloth, but refused to stay the needle and thread for even a moment.

uniques.name: Ifeh's Dire Totem
uniques.power: Grizzly Rage is now a Werewolf Skill and Shapeshifts you into a Dire Werewolf. Dire Werewolves gain #% Critical Strike Damage, #% bonus Poisoning damage and Spirit Cost Reduction instead of Armor. In addition, kills Heal you for #% of your Maximum Life.
uniques.flavor: Fiacla-Géar's druids lived in harmony with nature. The Talons of Ifeh walked a different path. They surrendered their souls to the wilds, becoming more beast than man.

uniques.name: In-Geom
uniques.power: Defeating an Elite pack reduces your Skill Cooldowns by # seconds for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Ahh, the In-Geom! The royal smiths of Xiansai folded the spirits of not one—but four tigers into the steel! Come! Put your ear to its edge. You can almost hear them... Meow!" -Covetous Shen

uniques.name: Indira's Memory
uniques.power:
Blood Wave is additionally a Bone Skill. It spawns a Bone Prison at its end point and increases your Blood Skill damage by #% for # seconds when Cast.

All Bone Spears are additionally Blood Skills. Your Bone Spears consume a Corpse to launch another Bone Spear and drain #% of your Maximum Life.
uniques.flavor: "The tears of Linarian turned bloody over Indira's torn body. Many days, unyielding, he poured his magic into sundered bone and rended sinew. Though the flesh did mend, his beloved did not rise..."

uniques.name: Infernal Homunculus
uniques.power: Your Archfiend Skills deal #% increased damage and casting any Archfiend Skill activates all their Lesser Demon Upgrades for free with #% longer durations.
uniques.flavor: It grows restless in silence, thrashing against its bindings. Though the body is small, it dreams of carnage unimaginable.

uniques.name: Insatiable Fury
uniques.power: For # seconds after Casting Trample, you may Cast Trample again without incurring the Cooldown. Trample additionally deals #% bonus damage.
uniques.flavor: When the Days of Ash began, the great druid Nafain reminded his disciples that nothing, not even the loss of their humanity, was too great a sacrifice to protect Túr Dúlra from Astaroth's flames.

uniques.name: Jacinth Shell
uniques.power:
Spending Vigor Heals you for #% of your Maximum Life.

Every second, your active Cooldowns each drain #% Maximum Life from you to reduce their durations by # seconds.
uniques.flavor: This ceremonial armor was once adorned during the He Sutsar Puchē, where sacred blood is drawn by jacinth lancets and offered to flames. It retains the scents of incensed smoke and scorched copper.

uniques.name: Judgment of Auriel
uniques.power: Arbiter of Justice gains all Variants and grants you #% increased damage and Damage Reduction for each Skill Rank it has while in Arbiter form. This bonus doubles for # seconds after Arbiter of Justice lands.
uniques.flavor: At dawn, she sits in Judgment's stead. The host shall kneel in her radiance.

uniques.name: Judicant's Glaivehelm
uniques.power: Lucky Hit: Judicator Skills have up to a #% chance to call down a Blessed Spear that carries a Judgement mark and deals Judgement's damage on impact.
uniques.flavor: "Let the righteous spear judge what man cannot. Its point unmasks the heretic, its edge silences their defiance." - Judicator Moseph of the Fourth Inquisition

uniques.name: Kabraxis' Will
uniques.power: Wall of Agony gains the Fallen Army Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
In the Sunless Depths, Kabraxis wailed.
No vessel could bare the Imprisoned Lord.
Creation could not sustain the road he traveled, only madness remained.

uniques.name: Kessime's Legacy
uniques.power: Blood Wave now forms a wave on each side of you. Both waves converge at your feet, Pulling In all surrounding enemies and exploding for # damage.
uniques.flavor: "Too soon she was taken, yet Rathma let Kessime rest in death, for they both had found peace in the cycle. Upon the hill where she lay, Rathma poured forth his blood and no evil trod thereafter..."

uniques.name: Khamsin Steppewalkers
uniques.power: Earthen Bulwark gains the Earthen Shrapnel Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Once worn by the lost druids who sang the sandy gales to sleep. When their line was broken, the desert rose in mourning, staining the sky blood-red as Kehjistan choked beneath fifty years of dust.

uniques.name: Kilt of Blackwing
uniques.power: Ravens deal #% increased damage and Shapeshifting into a different form or activating a Companion Skill Summons a Raven that attacks nearby enemies. Summoning a Raven has a chance to call forth an Unkindness for # seconds, increasing the number of Ravens Summoned to # for the duration.
uniques.flavor: "The moors once belonged to the raven-changelings, child. They came with the full moon and read fate through the eyes of the dead. But that time has withered. Their songs are stilled." - Airidah

uniques.name: Leoric's Crown
uniques.power: This item counts as Jewelry and increases the effect of any gem socketed into the helm by #%
uniques.flavor: "Heavy, isn't it?" Leoric said, fussing with his new crown, "The weight alone might topple me from the throne." Archbishop Lazarus only smiled, calm and cold. "It catches the Light well, your grace."

uniques.name: Levin Grasp
uniques.power: Spark shocks enemies #-# additional times and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The bandit lay on the floor, as a bolt of lightning arced between his friends. He watched the Sorceress walk away calmly as his friends fell to the floor, one by one.

uniques.name: Lidless Wall
uniques.power:
Lucky Hit: While you have an active Bone Storm, hitting an enemy has up to a #% chance to spawn a Bone Storm around their location.

Each Sacrifice bonus increases this chance by #% and allows you to spawn # additional Bone Storm. Each active Bone Storm grants #% Critical Strike Damage, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: Initially an unpopular choice to replace Mendeln as Deathspeaker, Daros quickly proved his worth with the creation of this masterpiece.

uniques.name: Light's Rebuke
uniques.power: Enemies impaled by the first strike of Divine Lance take #% increased damage from Divine Lance's subsequent hits.
uniques.flavor: "Stand tall, for on this day we bring the Light of Inarius to a land consumed by darkness!" - Urivar, before the Battle for Scosglen

uniques.name: Litany of Sable
uniques.power: Dread Claws deals #% increased damage and additional claws fire out when you gain a stack of Shadowform.
uniques.flavor: "Adiya shrouded herself in shadow and walked amongst men. From her countless mouths poured the song of the abyss. Its sound drowned the mind in fog as she came to feed." -Annals of Hadal

uniques.name: Locran's Talisman
uniques.power: Critical Strikes deal #% increased damage but your Critical Strike Chance is reduced by #%.
uniques.flavor: A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.

uniques.name: Loyalty's Mantle
uniques.power:
While your Spirit Hall choices match:
Their bonuses are #% more potent.
Skills of their Base Spirit gain #% Vigor Cost Reduction.
Skills of their Base Spirit gain #% Cooldown Reduction.
uniques.flavor: During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.

uniques.name: Lurid Pact
uniques.power: Rampage deals #% increased damage. Each enemy or demon killed by Rampage increases the size of the brute and its smashes by #%, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: "It glows because it is pleased." -Author Unknown, blood used as inscription

uniques.name: Mace of King Leoric
uniques.power: Your Golem will consume one of your Skeleton Mages or Skeleton Warriors every # seconds, healing to full Life and gaining #% increased damage for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Listen, no Skeleton is gonna be my King. Leoric is King. King, so you hear me? Hail to the King!" -Farnham

uniques.name: Mad Wolf's Glee
uniques.power:
Lacerate has no Cooldown, costs # Spirit to cast and deals #% bonus damage but no longer grants Immunity.

Lacerate is also a Core Skill.
uniques.flavor:
"He was not a victim of the curse. He sought it out. As his muscles grew and body changed from man to beast, his laughter never ceased."
– Tale of the Mad Nobleman

uniques.name: Malefic Crescent
uniques.power: Blood Howl is automatically cast when you Shapeshift into a Werewolf and every # seconds while in Werewolf form. In addition, you gain #% bonus damage for # seconds whenever Blood Howl is triggered.
uniques.flavor: "Túr Dúlra sat empty and the Cathedral sent forth two units. The full moon was thought to be a fair omen from the Heavens. They soon learned what else drew from its power." - History of Scosglen VI

uniques.name: Mantle of Mountain's Fury
uniques.power: Casting Hammer of the Ancients on an Earthquake explodes for their total damage and are consumed, and also causes your Hammer of the Ancients to deal #% increased damage for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "What you feel is the Ancients high on the mountain, my son. When they stomp their feet, the earth trembles! But fear not—it's our enemies they mean to warn." -Chieftess Naarah

uniques.name: Mantle of the Grey
uniques.power: Juggernaut Oath makes your Juggernaut Skills #% larger but Consumes up to # Resolve, granting #% increased Juggernaut Skill damage for each point Consumed.
uniques.flavor: The ensign bears the words: 'Beneath Saint Lalszo the Grey's gentle gaze, the cruel laid down their wrath, and the meek rose as lions. By his grace, no lost soul shall tread alone.'

uniques.name: March of the Stalwart Soul
uniques.power: Advance deals #% increased damage, gains # Skill Ranks, and travels twice as far.
uniques.flavor: "...and though he marched through shadow and storm, his flame never waned. On the thirtieth day, he arrived to spread the word of Akarat's passing." - Scrolls of Yaerius

uniques.name: Mark of the Old Wolf
uniques.power:
Gain #% bonus Poisoning damage.
Direct damage from Werewolf Skills gain a bonus equal to #% of your bonus Poisoning damage, up to #%.
Poison damage from Werewolf Skills gain a bonus equal to #% of your bonus Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance, up to #%.

Current Direct Damage bonus: #%
Current Poison Damage bonus: #%
uniques.flavor: "The tales spoke of a one-eyed wolf, a creature so cunning that it outsmarted the greatest trappers in the world. It makes you wonder if it was a wolf at all." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IX

uniques.name: Melted Heart of Selig
uniques.power:
Damage is dealt to your Primary Resource before Life and damage taken this way is drastically reduced.

Your Primary Resource is doubled but Maximum Life is reduced by #%.
uniques.flavor:
"Do not allow your passions to become obsessions. Fuel the fire that burns within you, but it is madness to allow yourself to become ash to please an uncaring universe."
- Last words of Master Selig

uniques.name: Messerschmidt's Reaver
uniques.power: Lucky Hit: Attacks have up to a #% chance to explode, dealing # Fire Damage and reducing your Cooldowns by 1 second.
uniques.flavor: Before the ashes of Old Tristram had cooled, the scavengers crept in—down into the crumbling cathedral to snatch anything of value. The late Prince Aidan's greataxe would fetch a fine price indeed.

uniques.name: Might of Qual-Kehk
uniques.power: Mighty Throw now gains multiplicative damage instead of cooldown from Cooldown Reduction at #% effectiveness.
uniques.flavor: "Even as a boy, Qual-Kehk's strength was the stuff of legend. It was said he could split oak trees in two with one throw of his blade." -Feats of Arreat, Vol. IV

uniques.name: Might of the Ursine
uniques.power: Gain #% bonus Werebear damage for each stack of Resolve while in Werebear form. Additionally, you automatically gain # stack of Resolve every # seconds while in Werebear form.
uniques.flavor: "To speak the tongue of a beast is more than just trading words. It changes how you see the world. It changes how you know fear, strength, and tenacity." -Greenwalker Ciórdan

uniques.name: Misericorde
uniques.power:
Lucky Hit: Dealing damage to an enemy affected by a Trap Skill has up to a #% chance to:
Reduce the active Cooldowns of your Trap Skills by #%
Increase your Trap Skill damage by #% for # seconds, up to #%
uniques.flavor: A trapped prey only awaits a swift death. Sisters of the Sightless Eye will grant them this mercy.

uniques.name: Mjölnic Ryng
uniques.power: While Cataclysm is active, you gain unlimited Spirit and deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: A singed wedding band, faintly crackling. It evokes an old rhyme where a bride receives a ring from her beloved, causing them to be struck thrice by lightning. Only the bride was unscathed.

uniques.name: Moloch's Beating Flame
uniques.power: Hellfire Skills deal #% increased damage for every Skill you have Empowered by Volatility. Casting a Volatility Empowered Skill increases you Core Stats by #% for # seconds, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: "Therefore, behold, the days come that it shall no more be called thine own body, nor thine own heart, but the heart of Moloch, for each heartbeat shall roar with the flames of Hell..." -Taphya 3:26

uniques.name: Molten Band
uniques.power:
Your Pyromancy Critical Strike Damage is increased by #% against Healthy enemies and your Pyromancy Critical Strike Chance is increased by #% against Injured enemies.

Killing an enemy with a Critical Strike grants both bonuses against all enemies as well as #% Attack Speed for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: Pillaged from the charred remains of Lord Bareen. It still feels hot to the touch.

uniques.name: Morlu Fleshward
uniques.power: You cannot recover above #% of your Maximum Life but your Defensive Skills deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "The morlu are incredibly resilient. Stories from the Sin War describe them fighting despite heavy wounds." -Book of Adria

uniques.name: Mother's Embrace
uniques.power: If a Core Skill hits # or more enemies, #% of the Resource cost is refunded.
uniques.flavor:
"Every tome, every scroll, every book in this temple produces the same answer. The only being willing to stand against the Eternal Conflict, against the Prime Evils, was Lilith."
- Elias

uniques.name: Mutilator Plate
uniques.power:
You are Blood Lanced, and when Blood Lance would deal damage to you, it instead Fortifies you for #% of your Maximum Life and has a #% chance to form a Blood Orb.

Blood Lance deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "The Cathedral of Light's earliest attempts at crafting their penitent armor was to infuse the plate with painful blood magic, before such acts were deemed heretical." -Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Nails of the Gore-Crowned
uniques.power: Hellion Sting deals #% increased damage and bursts out of enemies when you Eviscerate them. Hellion Sting gains #% Eviscerate Chance each second it has not Eviscerated.
uniques.flavor: "Bind them as a sign on your hand, and the fiend shall be as frontlets between your eyes. Nail yourself to your crucibles, for pain is the road where domination is won." -The Magnus

uniques.name: Nemesis Bracers
uniques.power: Shrines will spawn an Elite Pack.
uniques.flavor: Though tarnished by centuries, the bright steel is unmarked by battle. It inspires courage until one sees the padding, stained black with old blood. The names of bygone owners fade in the leather.

uniques.name: Nesekem, the Herald
uniques.power:
Every # seconds, you randomly mark a Nearby enemy. Marked enemies are Vulnerable, and your attacks against them are guaranteed to Critically Strike.

Hitting a marked enemy # times clears the mark from them.
uniques.flavor: In the days when Ajaw Y'ishich ruled Nahantu, the phoenix constellation's crown fell in burning glory. From it was forged a blade that withered valor, heralding an age of despair.

uniques.name: Night Terror
uniques.power: Your Abyss Skills deal #% increased damage for each stack of Shadowform. This bonus is increased by #% while you have Stealth.
uniques.flavor:
"Sleep, my child, shut fast thine eyes,
Keep thee still until sunrise.
Astrogha's brood will hear thy breath,
And lull thee close to dreaming death." -Westmarch lullaby

uniques.name: Nomad's Longing Heart
uniques.power: Core Skills deal #% increased damage, but cost #% more Fury. The damage is doubled against Injured and Healthy enemies.
uniques.flavor:
"O Crane, what news do you bring from our mountain?
Long have I been away, in strange lands.
I yearn for home, for the highland snows,
Why silent, Crane? Have you no news from Arreat?"

uniques.name: Okun's Catalyst
uniques.power: (PH) I need a new design! (Ball Lightning)
uniques.flavor: "Children and beast do tremble at thunder's roar, but the wise know to fear the silence of lightning." - Okun, of the Zann Esu

uniques.name: Omen of Pain
uniques.power:
A dark aura surrounds you, inflicting Decrepify and Iron Maiden on enemies around you and increasing your damage to Close enemies by #%.

Curses inflicted this way spread to surrounding targets every second.
uniques.flavor: "I have lost, more than I can put into words. Perhaps there are better ways to express loss than words...." -Rathma

uniques.name: Onyx Soul
uniques.power: Frozen Orb now returns to you dealing #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Many adventurers have sailed the Frozen Sea, but most are lost to the depths. Legend has it the first to return spoke of a vast treasure. Alas, he could not carry it alone. Save for one relic.

uniques.name: Ophidian Iris
uniques.power: Hydra is now a Core Skill with increased Mana cost and its attacks now explode dealing #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "Threefold was the sight of Oriax. He stirred the wrath of his lord Baal, and his eyes were torn and cast into the dust. Lo, the viper now crawls blind, writhing in misery." - Librarius Ex Horadrim

uniques.name: Orphan Maker
uniques.power:
Basic and Core Skills that use this weapon now Reload.
Reload Skills deal #% increased damage and every second Reload Skill increases this bonus by #% for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: This crossbow is marred by a hundred battles. Mercy is its stranger. When its quarrel flies, a generation weeps.

uniques.name: Orsivane
uniques.power: For each Defensive Skill not on your Action Bar, you deal #% increased damage and gain its associated Enchantment effect.
uniques.flavor: Lo, its strike is thunder, its sting a dirge. Those smote are unmade, scattered as chaff before the breath of ancients.

uniques.name: Overkill
uniques.power: Death Blow gains all Upgrades for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The malformed snake creatures that live in the swamps are not content with simply killing their prey. They seem to take a malicious pleasure from inflicting as much suffering as possible before death.

uniques.name: Pact of Bone
uniques.power:
Your Minions gain #% Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance.

When one of your Minions die, your other Minions enrage, dealing #% increased damage for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Can one befriend the dead? What loyalty is earned or granted in the act of reanimation? On this subject, there is much I have yet to understand." -Deckard Cain

uniques.name: Paingorger's Gauntlets
uniques.power: Damaging enemies with a Non-Basic Skill cast marks them for # seconds. When a Basic Skill first hits a marked enemy, the Basic Skill's damage is echoed to all marked enemies, dealing #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Crafted from fragments of Duriel's carapace, wearing these gloves, or being struck by them, causes an agonizing sensation akin to pushing one's hands through a thousand shards of glass.

uniques.name: Path of the Emissary
uniques.power:
You invoke up to # base Core Skills from your primary Spirit Hall split across every # meters you move.

While Ravager is active, Casting Core Skills instantly dashes you to your target.
uniques.flavor: "The path remembers the feet that tread it often. It bends its course to those who never stray." - Tarka, the Emissary

uniques.name: Path of Trag'Oul
uniques.power:
Bone Prison traps a larger area and fires # Bone Splinters at enemies trapped within.

Your Maximum Essence is increased by # for # seconds each time these Bone Splinters hit an enemy.
uniques.flavor: "Essence flows endlessly, shifting between vessels. It is through Trag'Oul, keeper of all known and unknown, that we serve as custodians, directing essence to travel new paths." -Mendeln ul-Diomed

uniques.name: Peacemonger's Signet
uniques.power:
While you have at least # stacks of Ferocity, you gain #% increased damage and #% increased Armor.

Gaining Ferocity also grants Resolve.
uniques.flavor: "In Natsalarwaka, no blood shall mar the earth. Even bitter enemies must forgo their blades before entering the haven. Breaking this accord will invoke Wasipotsu's wrath." - Oral Oaxazi Scripture

uniques.name: Penitent Greaves
uniques.power:
You are permanently Unhindered and leave behind a trail of frost that Chills enemies.

Your Chill effects cause enemies to take #% increased damage from you.
uniques.flavor: Remorseful devotees of the Cathedral of Light must undertake a grueling pilgrimage, journeying across the frigid glacier known as the Serac Rapture. Only then may their gravest sins be forgiven.

uniques.name: Pitfighter's Gull
uniques.power: Smoke Grenade bounces and detonates a second time. Smoke Grenade's damage is increased by #% and Duration is increased by #%.
uniques.flavor: "Ploughin' told you already! Hidden weapons are out – Yes, especially grenades! Behave yourself, or Morrick will skin you lot."- Purveyor of the Gea Kul fighting pits, on the eve of Morrick's murder

uniques.name: Protean Heart
uniques.power:
The Base Spirit of a Skill cast grants:
Eagle: #% Movement Speed
Gorilla: #% Damage Reduction
Jaguar: #% Attack Speed
Centipede: #% Life per Second

Casting a Skill of a different Base Spirit:
Swaps to the new bonus
Increases Core Stats by #% for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Nahantu is everchanging. Nahantu is everlasting. When the Burning Hells become ash and soot, and when the High Heavens come crashing down, Nahantu will remain." -Excerpt from Defiance of Enkasi

uniques.name: Protection of the Prime
uniques.power:
While moving, you gain #% Dodge Chance and Damage Reduction.

After standing still for # seconds, you become Unstoppable until you move.
uniques.flavor: "To commune with spirits, listen to whispers unseen. Root yourself unto the earth and let its pulse still the mind. Hear the ancient guardians – they rise to aid you." -Ysevete, the First Spiritborn

uniques.name: Purified Lightbringer
uniques.power: Pulverize pulls Distant enemies towards you. In addition, Pulverize deals #% bonus damage. This damage bonus is increased to #% if the target was pulled towards you, is Unstoppable or a Boss.
uniques.flavor: "The Cathedral fled south, leaving sanctums hollow and songs unsung. What was left—stone, silver, and sanctified relics—were claimed and bent to the will of elder root and spirit." -Bryona

uniques.name: Rage of Harrogath
uniques.power: Inflicting Damage Over Time on an enemy has up to a #% chance to reduce the Cooldowns of your Skills by # seconds.
uniques.flavor: Harrogath, the final bastion of resistance against Baal's assault on Mt. Arreat was destroyed along with the Worldstone. The survivors never forgave the betrayal that led to the loss of their home.

uniques.name: Raiment of the Infinite
uniques.power: Teleport pulls Close enemies to you and you gain #% Damage Reduction for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: The power you have is never enough.

uniques.name: Raiment of the Sea
uniques.power: Blizzard's effects linger on enemies for an additional #% of its duration.
uniques.flavor: The Firstborn sorrow is not forgotten, but sleeps in the sea, and in time wakes again.

uniques.name: Rakanoth's Wake
uniques.power: When you cast a Skill with a Cooldown, you explode, dealing # Fire damage.
uniques.flavor: Tread carefully on the plains of Hell, for each step sunders the soul and shatters the mind.

uniques.name: Ramaladni's Magnum Opus
uniques.power: Skills deal #% increased damage per point of Fury you have, but #% Fury Drains per second while in combat.
uniques.flavor:
"Without him the wine is less sweet, the hearth less warm, and our blades less keen. Our blood brother is gone, but Bul-Kathos willing, we will meet again one day."
- Sorrowsong for Ramaladni

uniques.name: Razorplate
uniques.power: Thorns has a #% chance to deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Crafted by the cannibal Armoda, each piece of this interlocking armor has been sharpened into a knife's edge. Even a century after death, the plate remained on her corpse, unable to be removed safely.

uniques.name: Red Blessing
uniques.power:
Gain # Maximum Overpower. Blood Orbs grant # stacks of Overpower.

Your Blood Skills consume # stack of Overpower to deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "The spark of life flows through blood, just as the spark of unlife flows through desiccated bone. There is power in both, if one knows how to use it." -Necromancer Zayl

uniques.name: Red Sermon
uniques.power: Zeal gains the Death or Glory Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "Thus spake Que-Hegan Sankekur the righteous: when prayer fails man, let the blade be our psalm. May the blood of unbelievers be the ink which we write our faith anew." -Excerpt from Brother Ismail

uniques.name: Rictus of Terror
uniques.power: Command Laalish is now an Ultimate Skill and deals #% increased damage. Command Laalish's Terror Realm lasts #% longer and while within your Abyss Skill casts do not break Shadowform Stealth.
uniques.flavor: "We found eight corpses, arranged around a summoning circle. No wounds or blood. They were frozen in mid-scream. Whatever had appeared in the circle was gone." -Caldeum guard report

uniques.name: Rimeblood
uniques.power: Frost Bolt pierces through Crowd Controlled and Unstoppable enemies and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
"We passed through the Fields of Judgement. The cold there...it chills your bones, and freezes your soul. Only I made it to the summit. The rest sit in prayer for eternity."
- The Pilgrimage of Agoa

uniques.name: Ring of Mendeln
uniques.power: Every 6th attack from each Minion is empowered, exploding for # Physical damage.
uniques.flavor: The signet of Mendeln ul-Diomed, the founder of the Priests of Rathma and the first Necromancer, was lost for over 3,000 years. The immense power over death held within, however, has not diminished.

uniques.name: Ring of Red Furor
uniques.power: After spending # Fury within # seconds, your next non-Channeled Core or Weapon Mastery Skill Cast within # seconds is a guaranteed Critical Strike and deals #% bonus Critical Strike Damage. Excess Fury grants #% additional bonus.
uniques.flavor:
"Anger brings strength but clouds the mind. You must learn to focus your fury, direct it with purpose. Keep our sacred duty at the forefront of your mind, always."
- Talic, to Madawc

uniques.name: Ring of Starless Skies
uniques.power: Spending your Primary Resource reduces the Resource cost of your Skills and increases your damage by #% for # seconds, up to #%.
uniques.flavor:
"Yours is the power to pluck the stars from the heavens with the ease of a child gathering fruit from the bough."
- Unknown

uniques.name: Ring of the Midday Hunt
uniques.power:
Your Maximum Vigor is increased by #%, and killing an enemy grants you # Vigor.

While you have Ferocity, your new Poisoning effects last #% longer.
uniques.flavor: "At midday thundered the first brother, Nyamoyo, lord of predators. Survival is his blessing, hunting is his prayer. Honor him and prowess shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse IV

uniques.name: Ring of the Midnight Sun
uniques.power:
When you Critically Strike, you regain #% of the Vigor you've spent in the last # seconds.

Gain Counterattack's Passive Effect.
uniques.flavor: "At midnight laughed the second brother, Nebahayomo, spirit of cunning. Trickery is his blessing, suffering is his prayer. Honor him and shrewdness shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse V

uniques.name: Ring of the Ravenous
uniques.power:
Rend's duration is increased by # seconds and deals #% increased damage.

Damaging enemies with your Brawling Skills applies # stacks of Rend's Bleed. This can only affect each enemy once every # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "The hunger, it starts so small, like a tickle in the back of your mind. You believe the lie that you still have control until you're so far gone you can't even recognize yourself." -Varyana

uniques.name: Ring of the Sacrilegious Soul
uniques.power: Corpse Tendrils gains the effect of every Upgrade and is automatically triggered once every # seconds. This timer is reduced by # seconds each second while there are corpses by you.
uniques.flavor: The mere proximity of a practitioner of such dark arts can rouse the dead and disturb those souls who have earned their rest.

uniques.name: Ring of Writhing Moon
uniques.power:
A Pestilent Swarm spawns from you every # seconds, dealing # Poison damage per hit.

Your Pestilent Swarms now orbit around you and reduce an equipped Eagle Skill's cooldown by # seconds per hit.
uniques.flavor: "Within this corpse-bound carapace we writhe. Chaotic winds converge to churn your bones. Our beat and breath a ceaseless war to break. The wretched cyclone black beyond the bounds." - Balazan's Dream

uniques.name: Rod of Kepeleke
uniques.power:
Your Core Skills are now additionally Basic Skills and free to cast.

When cast at Maximum Vigor, your Core Skills Consume all Vigor to cast at their largest Size, and become guaranteed Critical Strikes, with #% increased Critical Strike Damage for each point of Vigor spent this way.
uniques.flavor: "Beyond the world disc doth lie the keeper serpent Kepeleke. Ceaseless the serpent grows, and thus must ever consume his own tail, lest the world be overtaken." - Lintel XII

uniques.name: Rotting Lightbringer
uniques.power:
Every # seconds, Pulverize forms a puddle that deals #% of its damage as Poisoning damage over # seconds.

Pulverizing the puddle splashes an additional #% of the puddle's total damage within the area and around it.
uniques.flavor: "The Cathedral fled south, leaving sanctums hollow and songs unsung. What was left - stone, silver, and sanctified relics - were claimed and bent to the will of elder root and spirit." - Bryona

uniques.name: Rustbitten Dirk
uniques.power: Deal #% increased damage to isolated enemies.
uniques.flavor: This blade favors the unguarded, the unmourned, the straggler. For it knows that all bonds weaken in time, and that even kings may be found unguarded if patience is infinite.

uniques.name: Saboteur's Signet
uniques.power:
Your Grenades gain #% increased Size and deal #% increased damage.

Enemies damaged by Grenade Skills become either Vulnerable or Weakened for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "The element of surprise is the starting point. In this moment, be sure to finish it." - Kashya

uniques.name: Sabre of Tsasgal
uniques.power: You gain #% increased damage for each damaging Skill you have equipped, and an additional #% for # seconds when each of those Skills are used.
uniques.flavor: A foul blizzard trapped the clans after the Battle of Nine Winters. Then came a pale stallion born of the peaks, and the storm parted before him. Tsasgal, they named him - chief of all horses.

uniques.name: Sanctis of Kethamar
uniques.power: Arbiter form increases Aura Potency by #% and Wing Strike damage by #%
uniques.flavor: A token wrought from the siege of Kethamar. May the keep's defenders be anointed and borne aloft on hallow'd flame.

uniques.name: Sanguivor, Blade of Zir
uniques.power:
Your Summons' damage afflict enemies with Vampiric Curse. Consuming a Corpse also contributes # souls to Vampiric Curse, which can now stack up to # souls.
