Only Army of the Dead can now unleash the souls from Vampiric Curse, causing both Army of the Dead and the souls to deal #% increased damage per soul unleashed.
uniques.flavor: The parched blade keens, longing to serve its master.

uniques.name: Sashes of the Wretched
uniques.power: Summon a Tortured Wretch when your Current Life drops below #% of your Maximum Life. Enemies Tortured Wretch attempts to Taunt take #% increased damage and deal #% less damage for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Though unruly, demons are compelled to abide by certain rules. When a pact is forged, whether by force or choice, it must be upheld." -Deckard Cain

uniques.name: Scepter of the Three
uniques.power: You can now equip all Ultimate Skills and gain # Ranks in them. Hitting enemies with Non-Ultimate Skills builds up your Ultimate Skill damage by #%, up to #%. After starting Ultimate Skills the damage bonus is reset once all have ended.
uniques.flavor: "The Primes warred, but not for glory. They did so for the joy of mayhem. How many legions of demons died simply to delight the lords of Hell?" -Tal Rasha

uniques.name: Scorn of the Earth
uniques.power:
Your Evade is now Soar.

Soar deals #% increased damage and triggers Vortex at its landing location
uniques.flavor: "Sky Spirits weave the winds. Thunder is their laughter and auroras their crowns. Those they bless learn to scorn the earth, for from above, it is but a distant memory." - Lintel VII

uniques.name: Scoundrel's Kiss
uniques.power:
Gain # Ferocity every # seconds as long as no enemies are Close to you.

Your Marksman Skills deal #% increased damage per stack of Ferocity.
uniques.flavor:
"This'll blow your hair back."
- Lyndon

uniques.name: Scoundrel's Leathers
uniques.power: Your Trap Skills can be thrown and deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Rumor has it he lost them in a game of Skull & Anchor, but the boss is a devil with the dice. I think he wanted to give the poor sod something to keep him warm without wounding his pride."
- Elstir

uniques.name: Scourge of Duriel
uniques.power: Umbral Chains gains the Epicenter Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "Whereas Andariel relishes the anticipation of pain and the fear it creates, Duriel only cares of the existence and propagation of agony." -Book of Adria

uniques.name: Sea Lord's Fine Gloves
uniques.power:
Casting or Channeling a Cutthroat Skill grants a stack of Momentum, up to #. Casting a Marksman Skill removes a stack of Momentum.

For each stack of Momentum, you gain:
#% Maximum Energy
#% Energy Regeneration
#% Increased Damage
uniques.flavor: Pirates rarely gather under a single Captain, but when they do, they raid from Skovos to Xiansai. The last was known as the Scourge of the Twin Seas, and left a crimson wake for decades.

uniques.name: Seal of the Ophanim
uniques.power: Profane Sentinel deals #% increased damage and summons an additional eye that follows you for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: Upon the seal was graven the Name of the Ophanim. And though they were not demon, their will bent the same.

uniques.name: Seal of the Second Trumpet
uniques.power: Judgement deals #% increased damage and has a #% chance to explode twice when using the Judicator Oath.
uniques.flavor: "So is it written: when the Second Trumpet sounds, the wicked shall fall as stars cast down from their firmament." - Canticle of the Judgement, Verse XII

uniques.name: Seed of Horazon
uniques.power: Your Demonology Skills deal #% increased damage per Wrath you have and you take #% reduced damage per Dominance you have.
uniques.flavor: "In all dealings with Hells' spawn, names are both key and chain. To speak a demon's true name is to invite its presence, and seize some small dominion over it." -Master Horazon

uniques.name: Sepazontec
uniques.power:
Your Basic Skills deal #% increased damage and always use their 3rd attack.

Every 3rd cast of a Basic Skill strikes three times.
uniques.flavor: To the silent skies, the hunter Etzlek raised his staff and then smote the numen. "Release her!" came his cries as he desecrated the hallowed ground. On the third strike, the spirit answered...

uniques.name: Shanar's Resonance
uniques.power: Deep Freeze gains the Glacier Variant for free and its final blast deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Mage halls across Sanctuary boast of their prodigious alumni, trained from an early age. However, one might argue that these talented children would have become powerful Wizards in their own right.

uniques.name: Shard of Verathiel
uniques.power: Basic Skills deal #% increased damage but additionally cost # Primary Resource.
uniques.flavor: This blade once bore divine purpose wielded by the angel Verathiel. Like its keeper, the sword fell to Infernal depths. Yet beneath this corruption, is a heartbeat of a past memory, holding steadfast.

uniques.name: Shattered Vow
uniques.power: Enemies afflicted by more Damage over Time than remaining Life are Executed.
uniques.flavor: Malthael's last and only gift to mankind - a vow that our suffering shall end.

uniques.name: Shroud of False Death
uniques.power: When you would be dealt fatal damage, instead you Heal to full Life, gain a Barrier for #% of your Maximum Life for # seconds, and Knock Back Close enemies. This power is disabled once used until you return to town.
uniques.flavor: "Auriel alone saw past Lucion's guise. With Al'maiesh aloft, she smote the vile prince. Hatred's seed feigned death and waited, loath to enter the Abyss again." - The Great Conflict, Tome I

uniques.name: Shroud of Khanduras
uniques.power:
Casting Dark Shroud makes you Immune for # seconds, but your Evade Cooldown is increased by # seconds.

Evading while Dark Shroud is active leaves behind an explosion that deals # Shadow damage and Pulls In enemies.
uniques.flavor: "In fairer times, the Emperor gifted Prince Aidan a gilded shroud. Still a boy, not yet full height, it dwarfed poor Aidan. Briefly, Leoric's growing madness abated from laughter." -Deckard Cain

uniques.name: Shrouded Gift
uniques.power: Whenever you gain Stealth, you also gain Concealment. Gain #% increased Damage Reduction while Stealthed and for # seconds after breaking it.
uniques.flavor: "Deep in the Labyrinth, I found true darkness. The Hidden became my shadow, their attacks sudden and relentless. But I studied them, and found I too can enter the ether." -Moreina's Journals

uniques.name: Sidhe Bindings
uniques.power: Gain Familiar's Enchantment and Familiar's Potency is increased by #%.
uniques.flavor: "While known for their proclivity for mischief, the Sidhe, as the Druids call them, are fiercely loyal and will defend all they consider friend..." - Sarnakyle

uniques.name: Signet of Pelghain
uniques.power: Your Freeze effects cause enemies to permanently take #% increased Cold damage from you for each second they are Frozen.
uniques.flavor: Ksathra's strike roiled the seas, swallowing the land. The sky raged, unleashing devastating storms. In a moment, their empire gone. Their bond forever broken. Her sister, no more.

uniques.name: Sire of Sin
uniques.power: Infernal Breath gains the Explosive Death Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "Azmodan has plied the honeyed lures of sin. Where terror and hatred break the soul, temptation bends the faithful knee for use." -Of Primes and Lesser Evils, Volume I

uniques.name: Skyhunter
uniques.power: Every consecutive Cast of Rapid Fire increases the amount of arrows it fires by #, up to #. Rapid Fire deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Genai took up her bow and aimed at the sun itself. The light burned her eyes, but her arrow flew true. Wounded, the sun hid, and brought forth the first night."
- Fable of the Great Sky-Hunt

uniques.name: Sliver of Hate
uniques.power: Chance on being hit to unleash Hatred, Fearing and inflicting # Corrupting damage over # seconds to surrounding enemies.
uniques.flavor:
"The path ahead is steep. My blessing will guide you. Tread without fear."
- Mephisto

uniques.name: Soulbrand
uniques.power:
Your Healing Potions grant a Barrier for #% of your Maximum Life for # second.

You gain #% Damage Reduction while you have a Barrier and may drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.
uniques.flavor:
"To create such an artifact would require an impossible mastery over alchemy, transmutation and the subtle magics of the soul. By all rights, it should not exist, yet it does."
- Artisan Callas

uniques.name: Spine of Tathamet
uniques.power: Hell Fracture deals #% increased damage and every #rd cast creates a triple fracture.
uniques.flavor: "...Tathamet's blackened, smoldering husk spiraled into the lower darkness of reality. From his putrid flesh grew the realms of the Burning Hells." -The Black Book of Lam Esen

uniques.name: Squirt's Blouse
uniques.power: While not taking damage, you take up to 50% more damage and deal up to #% more damage. This bonus is reset upon losing Life.
uniques.flavor: It looks like the blouse of a street urchin with a crude stone pendant. But the inside is lined with hidden pockets and sinister sheathes. And on the back of the pendant? A old runic word: "Kantwirt."

uniques.name: Staff of Endless Rage
uniques.power: Fireball deals #% increased damage and every 3rd Cast launches 2 additional projectiles.
uniques.flavor:
"Leaving even blackened bones for your kin to mourn is too good an end for you."
- Josiah

uniques.name: Staff of Lam Esen
uniques.power: Charged Bolts deal #% increased damage, last #% longer and seek enemies.
uniques.flavor:
"Also known as the Greatstaff of the Old Religion, this powerful relic is one of only a small handful of Skatsimi artifacts that have survived to this day."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Staff of Zerae
uniques.power: Unstable Currents increases your Armor and Resistances by #% and kills increase your damage by #% for the duration.
uniques.flavor: "To walk the Path of Zerae, do not seek to control the storm within. Lose yourself to it, let it leave your body and become your shroud. Then you will see yourself as its master." -Queen Xaera

uniques.name: Starfall Coronet
uniques.power:
Meteor Casts consume Overpower when possible, dropping an additional Meteor for every # Overpower consumed.

Meteor deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor:
"The elders say they saw a star falling from the sky many years ago. A sign from the heavens that the end times were nigh. A rallying cry to take up arms and protect Sanctuary!"
- Crusader Hamilton

uniques.name: Stone of Jordan
uniques.power: Your Resistances are each equal to your highest, and you deal #% more damage of that Element.
uniques.flavor: Nine out of ten appraisers would see a dull stone. Crudely cut. Simply set. But a trained eye might see past the illusion placed by its Ammuit craftsman...and marvel at the wellspring of magic within.

uniques.name: Stone of Vehemen
uniques.power: Gain #% to All Resistances while channeling Stone Burst. Stone Burst's final explosion deals #% bonus damage split between all targets caught in the blast.
uniques.flavor: Long ago, the Stone Clan laid the foundations of Old Kurast. They shaped earthen marvels, but wars with the Vizjerei turned chisel into spear. Now the only stone they wield is when cast against foe.

uniques.name: Storm's Companion
uniques.power: Your Wolf Companions are infused with the power of the storm, dealing #% increased Lightning damage and gaining the Storm Howl ability.
uniques.flavor:
"The storm's rage is my own, brother. I call, and the skies roar in reply."
- Vasily, to Bul-Kathos

uniques.name: Strike of Stormhorn
uniques.power: Ball Lightning deals #% increased damage and explodes for #% of its total damage when dissipating.
uniques.flavor: The height of the Moon Clan's power brought a beast that instilled dread upon Khanduras. More demon than Khazra, the one dubbed the Stormhorn left charred brands where cities once stood.

uniques.name: Sunbird's Gorget
uniques.power:
Picking up a Storm Feather forms a firestorm around you for # seconds dealing # Fire damage every # seconds.

Every # additional Storm Feathers you pick up intensifies the firestorm, increasing its damage by #% but not refreshing its duration. Storm Feathers are now Jaguar Skills and the firestorm is an Eagle, Jaguar, and Storm Feather Skill.
uniques.flavor: Long ago, the Sunbird swallowed the sun whole. In the dark, the Spiritborn Xipil crawled to its nest and tore the sun free from the bird's gullet. Since, its throat was scorched red for its folly.

uniques.name: Sunbrand
uniques.power: Heaven's Fury gains # additional rays and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "The sun looked upon man and judged him unworthy. In wrath, the sins of the faithless were scourged in flame upon their flesh. And the day was made pure again." - Canticle of the Penitent, Verse XV

uniques.name: Sundered Night
uniques.power:
Casting an Aura Skill triggers a Consecration beneath you.

You gain #% Aura Potency while standing in Consecration.
uniques.flavor: "Heat struck my face and I thought the sun had risen early. Each swing of the hammer cleaved through the hordes, and every man shouted, wild with awe: The night ends!" - Survivor, Battle of Westmarch

uniques.name: Sunstained War-Crozier
uniques.power: Your Focus Skills benefit from all their Upgrades, and they increase the damage of your Potency Skills by #% for # seconds, up to #%.
uniques.flavor: "A relic of an old, forgotten religion lost to time and expansion. The staff retains a faint warmth as if still blessed by the dead god it once served." - Ser Paget's notes from the Tiklan excavation

uniques.name: Supplication
uniques.power: Brandish unleashes in all directions dealing #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The scroll's words are known to the knight alone. He supplicates to his sworn oath, lest his faith and blade find no purchase.

uniques.name: Tal Rasha's Iridescent Loop
uniques.power: Casting a Pyromancy, Shock, or Frost Skill increases your damage by #% for # seconds, stacking once per Element. Casting again refreshes all bonuses if the previous skill was a different Element.
uniques.flavor:
"Fool said he dug it out of the sands near Lut Gholein with a few other 'worthless trinkets'. I hid my delight at receiving such a treasure in exchange for a meager handful of coins."
- Rakhaan

uniques.name: Tassets of the Dawning Sky
uniques.power: When you take damage from a Non-Physical damage type, you gain #% Resistance to that damage type for # seconds. This effect can only apply to one damage type at a time.
uniques.flavor:
“May the Light of Father Inarius shine down upon all weary travelers of this holy land. Turn your face toward his radiance and find your strength renewed.”
- Statue Inscription

uniques.name: Temerity
uniques.power:
Effects that Heal you beyond #% Life grant you Barrier equal to #% of the overhealed amount that lasts for # seconds.

You may now drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.
uniques.flavor:
"The revelation that master tailor Callas was in fact a witch only served to further fuel the desire for her uniquely enchanted legwraps."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Tempest Roar
uniques.power: (PH) I need a new design! (Werewolf)
uniques.flavor:
"Listen, child, to the music of the storm. It has its own rhythm. Its own melody. Hear how beautifully it sings, and perhaps one day you will be able to join in its harmony."
– Airidah

uniques.name: The Basilisk
uniques.power: Petrified enemies have a #% increased chance to be Critically Struck and take #% increased damage. Additionally, Earth Skills Petrify Healthy enemies for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Well did she feed her children, and well did her children feed her." -Scosglen folktale

uniques.name: The Blade of Sight Aflame
uniques.power: Hitting a Lesser Demon with Bombardment explodes it for #% of a Bombardment impact if the Demon has less than # seconds duration left. Bombardment deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The third lord of Hashir hungered to see all beneath his rule. A Warlock obliged and bound a demon into steel. The king bore the blade and beheld how his realm was cast down before him.

uniques.name: The Butcher's Cleaver
uniques.power: Your attacks Critically Strike Injured Enemies. Killing Elites Fears and Slows nearby enemies by #% for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: A nightmarish amalgam of blood, bone and steel, this axe is as horrific, and as deadly, as its creator.

uniques.name: The Eightfold Idol
uniques.power: Blazing Scream leaves Sigil of Subversion Shadow or Lava trails behind. You deal #% increased Abyss or Hellfire Skill damage to enemies on Sigil of Subversion trails based on their type.
uniques.flavor: "There are depths of the Hells, and even deeper still in the Abyss, where the nameless await their appointed hour. They whisper truths forbidden that erode the mind even as they enlighten it." -Elias

uniques.name: The Fecund Seal
uniques.power: Sigil of Summons deals #% increased damage and you can summon up to # additional Lesser Demons with # kills outside the ritual.
uniques.flavor: "The apprentice called for one. Two answered. Then the third crawled out afterward, unfinished, screaming like it had been torn free too early." -Master Azevera

uniques.name: The Furnace
uniques.power: You deal #% more damage to Elites.
uniques.flavor: "What plague has befouled, let fire make clean. What agony these good people have suffered, let it settle quietly in the dust." -General Arenton

uniques.name: The Gloom Ward
uniques.power: Shadow damage infects enemies with Shadowblight for # seconds. Every #th time an enemy receives Shadow damage from you while they are affected by Shadowblight, they take an additional #% of that damage as Corrupting damage over # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "Necromancers uphold the Balance between Light and Dark, life and death. Yet it is only natural, only human, that an individual might tend toward one or the other." -Deckard Cain

uniques.name: The Grandfather
uniques.power: Increases your Critical Strike Damage by #%.
uniques.flavor: An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.

uniques.name: The Hand of Naz
uniques.power:
Your maximum number of Skeleton Mages is increased by # and they are upgraded to Arch-Mages.

Arch-Mages teleport to safety when attacked and their attacks occasionally shatter on impact, dealing #% increased damage to the enemy and up to # additional targets.
uniques.flavor: Legends say that the Hand of Naz was not made, but cursed into being. Woe to the living who unearth it, for the price is the same regardless of form. The cavity where a gem once lay is empty.

uniques.name: The Hemat Stone
uniques.power: Bonuses from Command Valloch and the Ritualist Shard and its Fragments have #% increased Potency. Your Occult Skills deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The warlock stared into the blood-stone until his eyes were scorched with dread knowledge. He felt an infernal current awaken in his veins—a plague of visions, malice, and command over the occult.

uniques.name: The Maestro
uniques.power: Twisting Blades impales an extra set of blades into its target, dealing #% increased damage and creating additional blades that return to you.
uniques.flavor: "I am a symphony of blades at your disposal. No need to get your hands dirty, I will deal with any blood or body work. So, how much gold do you have?" -Mouse, Assassin for Hire

uniques.name: The Mortacrux
uniques.power:
When consuming a Corpse, there is a #% chance to also create a decaying Skeletal Simulacrum that seeks enemies but cannot attack. When it dies, it explodes for # Shadow damage.

This effect is treated as a Macabre Skill.
uniques.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Nearby corpses shudder in its presence.

uniques.name: The Oculus
uniques.power: Each enemy hit by Teleport increases the damage by #% and reduces the Cooldown by # of the next Cast. Becoming Injured will Teleport you to a random location.
uniques.flavor:
"The rhythm of the orb, which had pulsed steadily for five centuries, quickened as its owner took his final ragged breaths. It were as if some intelligence within reveled in the sight."
- Master Eos

uniques.name: The Open Eye of Gorgorra
uniques.power: When inflicting Damage Over Time, you have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to increase the damage amount by #%.
uniques.flavor: Ever watchful were the Patriarchs, as the Unclean slowly made their way out of the Dreadlands.

uniques.name: The Relentless Heart
uniques.power: Hammer of the Ancients deals #% increased damage on consecutive hits to the same target. This stacks up to # times.
uniques.flavor: "Though he was stuck with a dozen arrows, the barbarian charged Rakkis' lines and swept away any who stood before him. The more he bled, the more ferocious were his blows." -The Chronicles of Rakkis

uniques.name: The Third Blade
uniques.power: Your Weapon Mastery Skills are now also Core Skills that have #% Cooldown Reduction but cost Fury, dealing #% of normal damage.
uniques.flavor: "Restraint, mercy, honor...these are shackles, forged by the weak and the conquered." -Hephasto, the Armorer

uniques.name: The Umbracrux
uniques.power:
Your Subterfuge Skills create an attackable Shade Totem for # seconds. Any damage it takes is replicated onto surrounding enemies at #% effectiveness.

This effect is treated as a Trap Skill. You may only have # Shade Totems active at a time.
uniques.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Bitter voices whisper from the blade.

uniques.name: The Undercrown
uniques.power:
Your maximum number of Skeleton Warriors and Skeleton Mages is increased by # and your Summon damage is increased by #%.

Commanding Skeleton Warriors also causes Skeleton Mages to focus the same target for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "There is no true death. There is only the movement from one world to another. I stand in both of these worlds." -Necromancer Zayl

uniques.name: The Unmaker
uniques.power:
Soulrift's duration is increased by # seconds for every # Essence you spend while it's active, up to # seconds.

Soulrift deals #% of its Shadow damage per second to surrounding enemies for every # Essence you gain while it's active.
uniques.flavor: Urzael rent asunder his own wings and armor with a fury unbridled. For never would he bow to the doom of mortals, nor endure defeat at their lowly hands.

uniques.name: Thousand-Eye Reaver
uniques.power: Moving grants Ferocity, and Maximum Ferocity is increased by #. Ferocity also increases Movement Speed by #% per stack.
uniques.flavor: No falsehood could endure the Thousand-Eyed King's reaver nor its countless eyes. Their gaze was bright and terrible, consumed with a world-eating hunger.

uniques.name: Thrice-Woven Nightmare
uniques.power: Terror Swarm gains the Devouring Swarm Variant for free and deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Faint screams emanate from the gloves, as if they are imbued with a hundred primal fears.

uniques.name: Thundergod's Blessing
uniques.power: Lightning damage against Close enemies has a #% chance to grant Resolve and deal #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: The Unclean burned the Monastery, and all knowledge within. They beheaded the monks, and kept their tongues. All artifacts were lost - save for this.

uniques.name: Tibault's Will
uniques.power: You deal #% increased damage and gain # Primary Resource Regeneration while Unstoppable and for # seconds after.
uniques.flavor:
"The younger apprentices think wearing heavy plate in the swamps is foolish. They fail to understand that our armor is our legacy, and without it we are nothing."
- Crusader Pembroke

uniques.name: Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty
uniques.power: When you gain Berserking while already Berserk, you become more enraged granting #% increased damage, # Fury per second, and #% Cooldown Reduction.
uniques.flavor: As he fought with side by side with Raekor to liberate the labor camp, Joritz claimed this dented helm from a fallen foe. As his legend grew, its unique shape became synonymous with his great deeds.

uniques.name: Twin Strikes
uniques.power: Double Swing's initial sweep deals #% increased damage and applies Vulnerable. Subsequent swings deals #% increased damage and grants Berserking for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "When hitting it once doesn't kill it, hit it twice." -Bear Tribe Proverb

uniques.name: Tyrael's Might
uniques.power: Gain #% Damage Reduction. While at full Life, your Skills unleash a divine barrage dealing # damage.
uniques.flavor:
"Thus Tyrael, a perfect aspect of Justice, came to be. None were more vehement against the forces of hell. All demonic entities learned to shudder at Justice's might."
-The Books of Jarl, Volume I

uniques.name: Ugly Bastard Helm
uniques.power:
Casting Wrath of the Berserker causes you to explode, dealing # Fire damage. While Wrath of the Berserker is active, your direct damage dealt is converted into Fire.

You deal #% increased Fire damage.
uniques.flavor: "Ah, Burning Hells. You look like one of Zolmog's inbred bastards." -Varyana

uniques.name: Unbroken Chain
uniques.power: Swapping weapons increases the damage of Iron Maelstrom by #% for # seconds, stacking up to # times.
uniques.flavor: After the warmaster Raekor freed her people, the Oxen tribe continued to wear their collars and chains to honor those who died in thralldom under the Samauren Empire.

uniques.name: Unsung Ascetic's Wraps
uniques.power: Lightning Storm gains 1 additional strike each time it grows and deals #% bonus damage.
uniques.flavor:
"The storm caller returns, day after day, demanding to meet the Tree. He beats his chest and demonstrates his powers, refusing to believe that he will never be chosen."
- Excerpt from Gulyas' Diary

uniques.name: Vasily's Prayer
uniques.power: (PH) I need a new design! (Werebear)
uniques.flavor:
"Roots from the Great Oak growing at the seaward statue of Vasily will, on rare occasions, be found twisted back upon themselves, suffused with ferocious magic."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Vengeful Sinew
uniques.power:
Bone Spirit explodes an additional time, dealing #% of normal damage.

Bone Spirit deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: "There have been tales, though I cannot attest to their veracity, of Necromancers drawing power from their anger, from their belief that the world has shifted far out of Balance." -Deckard Cain

uniques.name: Vision of the Firestorm
uniques.power: Firewall has #% increased damage and it's size is overcapped by #%.
uniques.flavor: "From the Judgement of Inarius, the Firstborn faced suffering of all kinds. As the land of Atanos sank, the land of Skartara erupted..." -Tome recovered from Kasama

uniques.name: Vox Omnium
uniques.power: Casting a Core Skill triggers a random equipped Basic Skill at a random enemy which deals #% increased damage.
uniques.flavor: Your incantations are echoed by a chorus of the damned. Wield their torment, their vengeance, their pain against the Hellborne that tortured them.

uniques.name: Ward of the White Dove
uniques.power: Blessed Shield deals #% increased damage. Casting another Skill makes your next # Blessed Shields double this bonus and cost # less Faith to Cast.
uniques.flavor: "Of the world's first light she was borne - the White Dove, our most radiant Lady. Her visage none may behold, yet all warmed by dawn may call her friend." - Sir Morna, Order of the Dove

uniques.name: Waxing Gibbous
uniques.power: Shred deals #% more damage, and Shred has a #% chance to land an additional strike, up to # times.
uniques.flavor: The nights preceding the full moon are sometimes far more dangerous than the event itself. The frenzy has begun to rise, yet the night is just dark enough to obscure a hunter from their prey's sight.

uniques.name: Wendigo Brand
uniques.power: Every # kills in the last # seconds increases your damage by #%, and Attack Speed by #%.
uniques.flavor: In the first winters, a desperate spirit awoke within the hearts of men. Where famine walked, the spirit strengthened. When men consumed one another, it found its name.

uniques.name: Widow's Web
uniques.power: Your Critical Strikes cause your Poisoning on an enemy to burst, dealing #% of the total Poisoning instantly to them and #% of the burst to surrounding enemies before removing the Poisoning effect from the primary target.
uniques.flavor: "One touch is all it took. She looked into my eyes, and I understood her hunger, endless and painful. I will start with the taverns and find a strong one, with strong blood." -Jios, Sarat's Servant

uniques.name: Wildheart Hunger
uniques.power: Rabies spreads #% faster and deals #% bonus damage (max #%) each time it spreads. Bosses take maximum bonus damage.
uniques.flavor: Do not seek comfort in the shapes of the moon, beastwalker. Its pallid light awakens a yawning hunger. Call the beast, but do not tarry. Lest you never return to your own skin.

uniques.name: Will of Rathma
uniques.power:
Vulnerable, Weakened, Crowd Controlled, or Corrupted enemies are Afflicted, taking #% increased damage from you.

Curse Skills deal # Shadow damage when applied to Afflicted enemies.
uniques.flavor: "Prey not on innocents, but instill fear in those who would." -Books of Kalan

uniques.name: Will of Stone
uniques.power: Earth Spike is now a launched as a projectile. Upon impact, the projectile deals # damage to the target and summons 2-4 additional Earth Spikes.
uniques.flavor: "You Vizjerei believe your magic is greater than ours, so you come here seeking to become the master of this land? But I am a druid. I am the land!" -Druid Saoirse, at the defeat of Mage Lord Emre

uniques.name: Wilted Potential
uniques.power: This item is worthless as its power has been lost.
uniques.flavor: A relic of Yorin's ill-starred tempering. Regardless of success, Donan proudly displayed them all upon the mantelpiece... in fairer days.

uniques.name: Windforce
uniques.power: Hits of Barrage have a #% chance to deal triple damage and Knock Down enemies.
uniques.flavor:
"There have been numerous world-shaping conflicts throughout history. This bow has been found on the battlefield of every one, and always in the hands of the victors."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

uniques.name: Word of Hakan
uniques.power: Your Rain of Arrows is always Imbued with all Imbuements and deals #% increased damage to Distant enemies.
uniques.flavor:
"Let the great gates of Caldeum be sealed. Let its proud walls stand fiercely defended. The rest of Kehjistan may suffer this plague, but my city, and my people, will not."
- Proclamation of Hakan II

uniques.name: Wound Drinker
uniques.power:
Every time you deal Thorns damage, you gain # Vigor.

Gain Toxic Skin's Passive Effect.
uniques.flavor: The inner curve of this band is lined with thorns that tear the skin whenever it is unbound.

uniques.name: Wreath of Auric Laurel
uniques.power:
Lucky Hit: Holy Bolt has up to a #% chance to trigger Purify.

Purify causes enemies to take #% increased damage from you for # seconds.
uniques.flavor: "No darkness may crown the brow that bears this light. Its radiance shall endure beyond the fall of stars." - Litany of Purity, Verse VII

uniques.name: Writhing Band of Trickery
uniques.power: Your Subterfuge Skills create a Decoy Trap that Taunts and lures enemies, dealing # Corrupting damage over # seconds. This counts as a Trap Skill and only one Decoy can be active at a time.
uniques.flavor: The ring shifts and spins on your finger as the forces within desperately attempt to escape.

uniques.name: Wushe Nak Pa
uniques.power:
Casting an Ultimate Skill grants or amplifies its matching Primary Spirit Hall Bonus with #% potency for # seconds.

Your Ultimate Skills each gain an additional Skill Type:
The Seeker is a Focus Skill.
The Hunter is a Mobility Skill.
The Devourer is a Potency Skill.
The Protector is a Defensive Skill.
uniques.flavor: "Fear not the limits of your flesh, Spiritborn! As our ancestors said: wushe nak pa! Transcend your being!" - Maka

uniques.name: Wyrdskin
uniques.power: Attacks apply Vulnerable to Distant Enemies, and Weakened to Close Enemies. You deal #% increased damage to Enemies that are both Vulnerable and Weakened.
uniques.flavor: Each touch dulls pain. Enemies feel their vigor unravel as the poison withers their marrow and drinks deep of their strength.

uniques.name: X'Fal's Corroded Signet
uniques.power: Each Damage over Time type you apply explodes every second, dealing # damage over # seconds to surrounding enemies.
uniques.flavor: Skulking in the shadows of the Realm of Destruction, the Scarred Baron plots the downfall of the mortal who banished him there.

uniques.name: Yen's Blessing
uniques.power: Casting a Skill has a #% chance to trigger a Non-Mobility, Non-Ultimate Skill that is currently on Cooldown. Can only occur once every # seconds.
uniques.flavor: These greaves are imbued with the divine blessing of Yen, the Veradani goddess of restoration. They bestow the wearer a revitalizing strength that enhances their own.
